command_expansion.method: command() expands $ARGUMENTS, then calls resolvePromptParts(template); file references deduplicated by path. Both references are the same absolute path. Full installed command is unchanged.

path_rule.why: In the observed non-Git project, the command resolver resolves relative @paths against worktree /, not the project directory.

cli_file_flag.finding: run --command passes no files to session.command; ordinary prompt branch does. This task uses @absolute-file in arguments, not --file.

file_read.important_boundary: The per-line substring operation does not set the whole-file truncated flag. Verify actual received content, not only that flag.

noReply.ordering: createUserMessage resolves attachment first; this guard returns before loop(). The loop contains title generation and agent model acquisition.

permission.native_attachment_source_behavior: User-selected file parts use native read with ask=>void and bypassCwdCheck:true. The chosen packet is separately within the explicit configured read allowlist. This preflight is neither model-selected tool use nor proof of OS containment.
permission.write_behavior: Pinned write.ts requests edit permission and writes with directories; it has no read-before-write assertion. No native generated-file write is yet observed.
